title: Shipping Policy
html:
Order Processing

We strive to get your order to you as quickly as possible. Please allow up to 24 hours for us to process your order. Within 2-3 days, you’ll receive an email confirming that your order is on its way!

Once your order is ready for delivery, we'll send you an email with real-time tracking information so you can monitor its journey to your doorstep.

Shipping Time

Orders are typically shipped within 1-2 days via domestic or international couriers. Shipping times can vary depending on your location, so please allow up to 5-7 days from the time your order was placed to receive it.

Shipping Costs

We are pleased to offer free shipping on all orders within the United States.

Any additional shipping discounts will be displayed at checkout.

International Shipping

Currently, we ship exclusively to the United States. However, we’re working on expanding our reach and hope to offer international shipping soon!
